# Lab 16.9: Data Science Agent in Notebooks

## What We Are Going to Do
Let the Data Science Agent explore, clean and model data inside a Colab Enterprise notebook.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Open a notebook.** Create a new notebook in BigQuery Studio and connect a runtime. Open the **Gemini / Data Science Agent** panel.

2. **[Console] Give it a task.**

3. **[Console] Follow the plan.** The agent writes a plan, then adds cells one by one. Read each cell before it runs. Approve or change the steps.

4. **[Console] Check its choices.** Look at how it handled missing values and which model it used (often BigQuery ML or BigQuery DataFrames). Ask *"Why did you choose this model?"*

5. **[Console] Save the notebook** as `lab16_data_science_agent` so the work is reproducible.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Plan | Visible before execution |
| Cells | Normal code you can edit |
| Output | EDA charts, cleaned data, model, metrics |
| Responsibility | Review every step |
